channel.title: iMirror
channel.description: Updates for iMirror, Android on your Mac.

item.title: iMirror 0.2.1
item.description:
Changed

  • iMirror's bundle identifier is now com.ourappsworld.app.imirror.macos (was dev.imirror.macos). Your trial carries over; if you had activated a licence, enter your key once more under iMirror › Licence… (it re-activates on the same Mac). If in-app update does not offer this version, download the DMG from the releases page.

item.title: iMirror 0.2.0
item.description:
Added

  • Licence. iMirror is free to try for 14 days with every feature. After that, iMirror Lifetime is a one-time $9 licence for one person, active on one Mac at a time, with every future update. Enter a key under iMirror › Licence… (⇧⌘L), or open the *Activate in iMirror* link after buying.
  • In-app updates. iMirror checks once a day for new versions (turn it off in Help & About), and *iMirror › Check for Updates…* checks at once. Updates are signed and verified before they install.
  • Help & About now shows your version, licence and update status, and the user manual covers the licence and updates.
